string.text: Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Increased magazine capacity
The high-capacity magazine (19 rounds) increases your chances of hitting the enemy without reloading.
Replacing the magazine
Installing a high-capacity magazine (33 rounds) can significantly reduce the number of reloads in battle and thereby increase the chances of hitting the enemy.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Muffler thread
Replacing the barrel with an elongated one, with a thread designed to install a silencer for 9x19 mm caliber.
Muzzle compensator
Replacing the barrel with an extended one with an integrated compensator can significantly reduce recoil.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Automatic fire mode

A complete replacement of the bolt frame and modification of the trigger mechanism parts adds the ability to fire automatic fire from the pistol.Due to the significantly increasing load on the pistol components, it is necessary to replace some of the components with non-standard ones, which significantly reduces the firing accuracy and reliability of the weapon.
Fire mode with a cut-off of three shots

A compromise between fully automatic and single-fire modes.The addition requires some modifications to the weapon (for example, replacing the bolt frame), but due to the slight increase in the load on the pistol components, their replacement is overwhelmingly not required.This allows, with much less loss of accuracy and reliability, to achieve efficiency comparable to a fully automatic version of the pistol.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A narrow-beam, long-range flashlight is indispensable for night forays, as well as when exploring unlit areas.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
